title: Multi-Tenant Cost Allocator
creator: Katie Jo Schuman
subject: AI economics
description: The learner will calculate each tenant's direct token cost, shared-cost allocation, and total allocated cost for the shared platform from request counts and per-request costs, to within $1.

learningObjectives: The learner will calculate each tenant's direct token cost, shared-cost allocation, and total allocated cost for the shared platform from request counts and per-request costs, to within $1.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit-then-explore: predict, receive feedback, then explore
commonMisconceptions: (1) Teams with equal request shares should pay equal amounts. (2) Shared costs should be split equally per team. (3) An assumed usage share is as good as a measured one.
assessmentOpportunities: For each of eight items the learner types a value before the answer is shown. A value is correct when it is within $1 of the model value for dollar items, or within 0.1 percentage points for the percentage item. Mastery is 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt. Exploration with the adjustable quantities is not evidence.
